mapper.sql: ID, PRJ_ID, SUBJECT, DESCRIPTION, CATEGORY_CD, STATUS_CD, PRIORITY_CD, CREATED_ON, UPDATED_ON, EST_START_DATE, DUE_DATE, START_DATE, CLOSED_DATE, PARENT_ISSUE, ROOT_ISSUE, MEM_ID, LFT, RGT, DONE_RATIO, IS_ATTACH_CD
mapper.select:
SELECT i.ID as id, i.PRJ_ID as prjId, i.SUBJECT as subject, i.DESCRIPTION as description, get_sub_code_name(i.CATEGORY_CD) as CATEGORY_CD, get_sub_code_name(i.STATUS_CD) as STATUS_CD, get_sub_code_name(i.PRIORITY_CD)as PRIORITY_CD, i.CREATED_ON as createdOn, i.UPDATED_ON as updatedOn, i.EST_START_DATE as estStartDate, i.DUE_DATE as dueDate, i.START_DATE as startDate, i.CLOSED_DATE as closedDate, i.PARENT_ISSUE as parentIssue, i.ROOT_ISSUE as rootIssue, GET_USERID_TO_NAME (i.MEM_ID) as memName, i.LFT as lft, i.RGT as rgt, i.DONE_RATIO as doneRatio FROM ISSUE i
ORDER BY PRIORITY_CD DESC

SELECT ID, PRJ_ID, SUBJECT, DESCRIPTION, get_sub_code_name(CATEGORY_CD) as CATEGORY_CD, get_sub_code_name(STATUS_CD) as STATUS_CD, get_sub_code_name(PRIORITY_CD)as PRIORITY_CD, CREATED_ON, UPDATED_ON, EST_START_DATE, DUE_DATE, START_DATE, CLOSED_DATE, PARENT_ISSUE, (SELECT P.SUBJECT FROM ISSUE P WHERE P.ID = ISSUE.PARENT_ISSUE) AS parentIssueSubject, ROOT_ISSUE, GET_USERID_TO_NAME (MEM_ID) as memName, LFT, RGT, DONE_RATIO FROM ISSUE WHERE ID = #{id}

SELECT ID AS id, PRJ_ID AS prjId, SUBJECT AS subject, DESCRIPTION AS description, CATEGORY_CD AS categoryCd, STATUS_CD AS statusCd, PRIORITY_CD AS priorityCd, CREATED_ON AS createdOn, UPDATED_ON AS updatedOn, EST_START_DATE AS estStartDate, DUE_DATE AS dueDate, START_DATE AS startDate, CLOSED_DATE AS closedDate, PARENT_ISSUE AS parentIssue, ROOT_ISSUE AS rootIssue, MEM_ID AS memId, LFT AS lft, RGT AS rgt, DONE_RATIO AS doneRatio, IS_ATTACH_CD AS isAttachCd FROM ISSUE WHERE ID = #{id}
mapper.update:
UPDATE ISSUE SET (CLOSED_DATE, UPDATED_ON,STATUS_CD ,DONE_RATIO,last_updater) = (SELECT SYSDATE, SYSDATE,'04ISSUESTAT',100,#{updater} FROM DUAL) WHERE ID IN #{id}
and closed_date is null
mapper.select: SELECT ID, PRJ_ID, SUBJECT, DESCRIPTION, get_sub_code_name(CATEGORY_CD) as CATEGORY_CD, get_sub_code_name(STATUS_CD) as STATUS_CD, get_sub_code_name(PRIORITY_CD)as PRIORITY_CD, CREATED_ON, UPDATED_ON, EST_START_DATE, DUE_DATE, START_DATE, CLOSED_DATE, PARENT_ISSUE, ROOT_ISSUE, GET_USERID_TO_NAME (MEM_ID) as memName, LFT, RGT, DONE_RATIO FROM ISSUE WHERE PARENT_ISSUE = #{id} ORDER BY ID DESC

SELECT c.ID, c.PARENT_ID, c.ISSUE_ID, c.CONTENT, c.WRITE_DATE, GET_USERID_TO_NAME(c.MEM_ID) AS memId, LEVEL AS depth FROM issue_comment c WHERE c.issue_id = #{id} START WITH c.parent_id IS NULL CONNECT BY PRIOR c.id = c.parent_id ORDER SIBLINGS BY c.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO issue_comment ( id, PARENT_ID, ISSUE_ID, CONTENT, WRITE_DATE, MEM_ID ) VALUES ( ISS_SEQ.NEXTVAL, #{parentId}, #{issueId}, #{content}, SYSDATE, #{memId} )
mapper.select: SELECT i.ID, i.PRJ_ID, i.SUBJECT, get_sub_code_name(i.STATUS_CD) AS STATUS_CD, GET_USERID_TO_NAME(i.MEM_ID) AS memName FROM ISSUE i WHERE i.ID IN ( SELECT mi2.issue_id FROM milestone_issue mi1 JOIN milestone_issue mi2 ON mi1.milestone_id = mi2.milestone_id WHERE mi1.issue_id = #{id} AND mi2.issue_id != #{id} ) ORDER BY i.ID DESC

SELECT H.ID AS id, H.ID AS historyId, H.TABLE_NAME AS tableName, H.TABLE_ID AS tableId, H.MEM_ID AS userId, H.UPDATED_ON AS updatedOn, H.DETAIL AS detail, U.NAME AS modifierName FROM HISTORY H LEFT JOIN USERS U ON U.ID = H.MEM_ID WHERE H.TABLE_NAME = 'ISSUE' AND H.TABLE_ID = #{id} ORDER BY H.UPDATED_ON DESC, H.ID DESC

SELECT mem_id, name, NVL("신규", 0) AS "신규", NVL("진행중", 0) AS "진행중", NVL("검토", 0) AS "검토", NVL("완료", 0) AS "완료" FROM ( SELECT NVL(i.mem_id, 0) AS mem_id, NVL(get_userid_to_name(i.mem_id), '미배정') AS name, get_sub_code_name(i.status_cd) AS status FROM issue i WHERE i.prj_id = #{prjId} ) PIVOT ( COUNT(*) FOR status IN ( '신규' AS "신규", '진행중' AS "진행중", '검토' AS "검토", '완료' AS "완료" ) ) ORDER BY mem_id

SELECT mem_id, name, NVL("최상", 0) AS "최상", NVL("상", 0) AS "상", NVL("중", 0) AS "중", NVL("하", 0) AS "하" FROM ( SELECT NVL(i.mem_id, 0) AS mem_id, NVL(get_userid_to_name(i.mem_id), '미배정') AS name, get_sub_code_name(i.priority_cd) AS status FROM issue i WHERE i.prj_id = #{prjId} ) PIVOT ( COUNT(*) FOR status IN ( '최상' AS "최상", '상' AS "상", '중' AS "중", '하' AS "하" ) ) ORDER BY mem_id

SELECT mem_id, name, NVL("버그", 0) AS "버그", NVL("기능", 0) AS "기능", NVL("작업", 0) AS "작업", NVL("개선", 0) AS "개선" FROM ( SELECT NVL(i.mem_id, 0) AS mem_id, NVL(get_userid_to_name(i.mem_id), '미배정') AS name, get_sub_code_name(i.category_cd) AS status FROM issue i WHERE i.prj_id = #{prjId} ) PIVOT ( COUNT(*) FOR status IN ( '버그' AS "버그", '기능' AS "기능", '작업' AS "작업", '개선' AS "개선" ) ) ORDER BY mem_id

SELECT ID AS id, PRJ_ID AS prjId, SUBJECT AS subject, get_sub_code_name(STATUS_CD) AS statusCd, CREATED_ON AS createdOn, UPDATED_ON AS updatedOn FROM ISSUE WHERE CREATED_ON > SYSDATE - INTERVAL '10' SECOND

SELECT ID AS id, PRJ_ID AS prjId, SUBJECT AS subject, get_sub_code_name(STATUS_CD) AS statusCd, CREATED_ON AS createdOn, UPDATED_ON AS updatedOn FROM ISSUE WHERE UPDATED_ON > SYSDATE - INTERVAL '10' SECOND AND CREATED_ON != UPDATED_ON
